docs:
Storybook Hero — A parchment hero with a glowing cottage in an arch.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep them together in components/blocx/.
It loads its fonts with next/font, so it expects a Next.js app (App Router).
Its images are not part of this package. Copy public/blocx/storybook-hero/ from https://github.com/shadcn-labs/Pin-UI/tree/main/public/blocx/storybook-hero into your own public/ folder (1 file), or change the paths at the top of the component.
